description: Na₂Cr₄O₁₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (2.83 Å) and one longer (2.94 Å) Na-O bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.80-2.93 Å. There are four inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.63 Å) and one longer (1.83 Å) Cr-O bond length. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.77 Å. In the third Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.78 Å. In the fourth Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.63 Å) and one longer (1.84 Å) Cr-O bond length. There are thirteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two Cr atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Cr atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two Cr atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Cr atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Cr atoms.
